collection.title: Audi A4 Avant 2004 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A4 Avant 2004 to 2008 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Slider Fit arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this A4 Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
